Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Roadmap to eval & commercial milestones — proposed MAP

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking the demo last week. Based on our conversation, I sketched a short mutual action plan that ties evaluation gates to pricing and commitment milestones so both teams have clear expectations on ramp and renewal economics. Attached is a working spreadsheet (MAP_Q4-draft.xlsx) with dates and deliverables.

High level:
- 4-week technical evaluation (sandbox access + two integration-checks)
- Week 5 pilot commit (50k inference tokens/month equivalent) with pilot discount applied
- Ramp to target production capacity over 90 days after pilot start (milestone-based discounts at 50% and 100% of target)
- Renewal: standard annual renewals with a recommit milestone review at month 10 to calibrate uplift incentives

Two asks from our side to make the MAP binding:
1) Procurement timeline (contact + target signature date) so we can reserve dedicated capacity in our Dedicated pool.
2) A short list of evaluation success criteria (latency p50/p95, utility metrics) so we can instrument regression alerts into the plan.

I've cc'd Laura (Customer Success) and Karthik (Commercial) to help with SOW and pricing guardrails. If this looks OK I can push a clean SOW draft and DocuSign link by Wednesday.

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas,

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the draft MAP. Melanie (CTO) and I reviewed it this morning. The structure makes sense — we like milestone-based discounts. A few clarification items before we commit to dates:

- Evaluation success criteria: we’ll provide a short list (throughput & latency targets, and a small set of example prompts) by Friday.
- Procurement: our legal/procurement lead (procurement@apertureanalytics.com) needs a 3-week review window. Our internal target is to sign a pilot SOW by 2026-12-28.
- Pricing ask: for a pilot commit and a 12-month follow-on, we need a cap on renewal uplift — our CFO wants no more than 7% YoY on list pricing for the first renewal unless scope materially changes.

Two requests from our side: can you confirm a price band for the pilot -> production ramp (so we can model TCO), and include a clause for service credits if p95 latency exceeds the agreed SLO during pilot?

If you can send a version of the SOW with pricing bands and the MAP tied to those milestones, we’ll route it through procurement.

Thanks,
Priya Desai
Head of Product | Aperture Analytics
priya@apertureanalytics.com

Subject: Re: Roadmap to eval & commercial milestones — proposed MAP

Priya — thanks, that’s helpful and reasonable. Drafting notes below and attached SOW + MAP.

Key commercial structure (proposal):
- Pilot (12 weeks total): 4-week technical eval, then a 8-week pilot commitment window. Pilot net price: $12,500/month (equivalent usage band), pilot discount = 25% off list for pilot months.
- Ramp bands after pilot:
  * Band A (50% of target): 10% additional discount for months 1–2 of ramp
  * Band B (100% of target): 5% discount thereafter, subject to milestone sign-off
- Renewal policy: list price applied at renewal; uplift cap 7% YoY guaranteed for first renewal provided customer meets consumption and payment milestones in the MAP; if scope increases (additional seats/models) uplift may be revisited.
- SLO credit: for pilot months, we will include a limited SLA credit (service credit up to 5% of pilot invoice for repeated p95 misses > 48 hours aggregated). Full SLA language to be in SOW.

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (pricing bands called out) and MAP_Q4-draft.xlsx (detailed milestone dates + acceptance criteria). I added placeholders for the procurement signature date and DocuSign link.

Next steps:
1) If procurement confirms a 3-week review, target signature = 2026-12-28 (we’ll reserve Dedicated capacity as requested).
2) Karthik / Laura to approve final pricing before I send DocuSign.

Connor: can you confirm we can hold the Dedicated pool (NVIDIA A100-equivalent) for the pilot window pending signature?

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber

jonas@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Fwd: Roadmap to eval & commercial milestones — proposed MAP

Forwarding Priya’s reply — procurement wants a 3-week review and a renewal uplift cap ask (7% YoY).

My take: granting a 7% cap for the first renewal is acceptable if we secure a 12-month committed follow-on after pilot and include clear consumption milestones. I recommended the SLA credit structure to limit exposure.

Karthik — recommend we hold the pilot pricing and the ramp-band discounts as drafted. If legal pushes on the uplift cap, propose the following compromise: 7% cap for year 1 renewal guaranteed as long as Aperture hits at least 85% of their committed usage for months 7–10; otherwise standard list uplift applies.

Connor — pls confirm Dedicated pool reservation. Laura — please prep onboarding checklist for pilot (two integration checkpoints + success criteria instrumentation).

Thanks,
Jonas
